collection.attribution: OpenSci mirrorless lens design study. The upstream design family used Sony numerical example 2 as its initial topology.
collection.contributor: OpenSci design studies, submitted through JunLin615
collection.redistribution: The contributor requested submission to os-optics-lens. A downstream reuse license for the prescription has not been specified.

design.source_reference: P2b finite-film and coated engineering model

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: SOURCE_STATED numerical wavelengths preserved from the source native Project

effective_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial EFL at the primary wavelength, 587 nm

back_focal_length_mm.definition: Paraxial distance from the final modeled optical surface to the rear focal point at 587 nm. The finite-conjugate or optimized fixed sensor plane is described by the separate vertex-to-sensor distance.

final_powered_vertex_to_sensor_mm.definition: Last powered surface vertex to the fixed sensor plane, including the H-K9 plate

total_track_mm.definition: Axial distance from the first surface vertex to the fixed image plane

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD at the primary wavelength, using the original unit-index propagation convention.

f_number.definition: Upper bracket of EFL divided by the physically admitted on-axis entrance-pupil diameter at infinity focus

field.definition: Object-space half angle to the full image diagonal at 587 nm

materials.basis: Original inline material and coating definitions preserved in project.json

performance.condition: Fixed detector, vector pupil autocorrelation of the three complex OTFs at equal spectral weights. This is the limiting nominal sample within the evaluated center-to-0.8 field set.
Fixed detector, same vector-pupil method as the 0.8-field sample.
Maximum chief-ray angle relative to the image-plane normal across the sampled wavelengths.
Modeled coatings, center-normalized projected transmitted pupil solid angle.
587 nm chief-ray height relative to rectilinear EFL × tan(angle), through full diagonal.

approximations.description: The only Project change is an explicit zero-pressure propagation setting in 0.14.0 so the original 0.13.0 numerical ambient index of one is retained. This is a simulation convention.

evidence_notes: Two 10 µm finite cement layers and the modeled broadband antireflection coating are preserved from the native Project.
The 40 lp/mm competition MTF criterion covers the center through 0.8 of the diagonal image radius. Pixel integration is outside the optical MTF calculation.
A replayed 96-build finite-film tolerance study gave 92 MTF passes under a three-cell active alignment process. Physical first-article performance and production yield are unverified.
